name: Thaba Bosiu
subtitle: A flat-topped sandstone mountain stronghold about 20 km east of Maseru, used by Moshoeshoe I as residence and fortress.

parts.text: A flat-topped sandstone mountain stronghold about 20 km east of Maseru, used by Moshoeshoe I as residence and fortress. Often called the historic and spiritual heart of the Basotho kingdom. (Not checked whether it is on the UNESCO Tentative List; verify before use.)
